name: XP seasons
description: Save the top three XP records, reset XP and advance a channel counter. Every operation uses public generic functions. Other saved fields are preserved.

stages.title: Read or initialize the season number
stages.source:
${set season readcountseason}
${if season == 0}${set season setcount season 1}${end}

stages.title: Reset the chosen field for everyone
Prepare an optional results message
stages.source: ${board "S${previous}"} • S${season} begins! XP is reset; other player records are unchanged.
